source: John Snow, On the Mode of Communication of Cholera, 2nd ed., 1855: Table VIII with Table XII's declared water supply, for people; Table IX for houses. The people-denominated table is derived inside Fieldwork by relate_table, group_table, derive_value and select_rows -- it is not transcribed.

tables.note: Snow Tables VIII and XII, on people: one company against the other

estimates.name: risk ratio
notes: A risk per people. A ratio computed over a different subject -- a house rather than a person -- is a different quantity even when the arithmetic looks the same.

estimates.name: odds ratio
notes: Both risks are under 10%, so the odds ratio is close to the risk ratio here. They are still different quantities.

estimates.name: risk difference
notes: A difference of risks, on the same scale as the risks themselves. Unpooled: each group contributes its own variance rather than a common one.
Epi Info AI's panel prints this as a percentage under "Risk Difference (RD%)": 0.4093% for the same figure. Same quantity, different scale.
